annotation.evidence_span: SHOULD send a Last-Modified value if it is feasible to send one.
annotation.interpretation_a: The server SHOULD send a Last-Modified date if it can, even if it doesn't change the response.
annotation.interpretation_b: The server SHOULD send a Last-Modified date only if the content has changed since the last request, and it is feasible to determine that.
annotation.justification: The term 'feasible' is subjective and lacks a concrete definition. This allows for different interpretations of when a server is required to send the Last-Modified value.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'feasible' is not provided. Does 'feasible' mean technically possible, or practically reasonable given cost/benefit? Without a clearer definition, implementations could reasonably differ on when to include the Last-Modified header.
